name: Mahou Shoujo o Mechakucha ni Shite Mita ~Houkai Akuda~
original_name: 魔法少女をメチャクチャにしてみた ～崩壊悪堕～
source:
The protagonist is an evil monster, Black Ripper.
He had slipped into the heart of his enemy, the justice forces commander, when he was shocked by a blast. Thereupon, using the commander, he is trying to lead the organization of justice to ruin, making magical girls plunge into evil.

To turn it to evil, he ought to make magical girls despair. Moreso, the more magical girls despair, the stronger they become.

Wouldn't it be a great shock if their commander betrayed them? The girls believe him from the bottom of their hearts. In addition, they are not thinking about him just as a commander. They seem to have deeper feelings for him.

If so, it would be beneficial to let them enter into relationships they desire. The protagonist thinks of getting involved with them deeper and then betraying them. A respected mentor in combat, a trusted superior of the base, and the dearest lover. He needs to become an irreplaceable being to magical girls.

And, becoming the most important person to the girls, he splendidly betrays them before their own eyes. And when they know that they were betrayed, grief will overcome them. The grief will lead to the birth of the most powerful dark magical girls.

Will the protagonist succeed in enslaving both the bodies and minds of girls, as he expects?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ010953.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主人公是邪恶怪物“黑色撕裂者”。

他潜入敌方正义部队指挥官的体内，却被爆炸冲击。于是，他利用这名指挥官，企图使正义组织走向毁灭，让魔法少女们堕入邪恶。

要让她们变邪恶，就必须让魔法少女陷入绝望。而且，魔法少女越绝望，力量就越强。

如果指挥官背叛了她们，岂不是会受到巨大打击？少女们从心底信任他，而且对他的感情并不止于指挥官。她们似乎还爱着他。

既然如此，让她们与自己渴望的人建立关系会很有利。主人公打算与她们深入交往，然后背叛她们。他必须成为魔法少女们在战斗中敬仰的导师、基地里信赖的上级，以及最珍爱的恋人。

成为少女们最重要的人后，他要在她们眼前华丽地背叛她们。得知自己遭到背叛时，悲伤将压倒她们，而这份悲伤会催生出最强大的黑暗魔法少女。

主人公能否如愿奴役少女们的身心？
